An authentic notarial deed may reproduce disputed party recitals without establishing falsity of the instrument or knowledge by the notary.

Document falsity requires the exact document, comparator, author, essential alteration/simulation/false attribution, knowledge and use; procedural fraud additionally requires deception, judicial error, adverse resolution and economic harm.
The present record does not prove false signatures, physical or digital alteration, notarial knowledge, collusion, a common criminal plan or completed offence elements.
